label: Engine batch 64
mechanism: server admission-cap default 8 -> 64 so bench conc-64 actually co-resides in one batched step
hypothesis: Ranked-next (1) from the exp-0005 profile row, cited per the STEP-B ruling: every bench row to date INCLUDING the 15.3 best ran the engine at internal batch 8 — server.py --max-batch defaults to 8 and the worker serve_cmd never overrides it (verified live on the exp-0004 process table) — so timeboxed(conc=64) concurrency queued at the HTTP layer instead of reaching the engine. The step is dispatch-bound (exp-0005: host enqueue = 100% of step wall, GPU busy 31-33%, 23,299 launches/step at B=8), so co-residing 64 rows amortizes the per-step host work across 8x tokens: measured in-process on this exact engine build, B=8 = 470 ms/step (17.0 tok/s) vs B=64 = 1989 ms/step (32.2 tok/s) — 8x tokens for 4.2x wall. Raising the default admission cap to 64 (2 default constants in server.py, no kernel or numeric-path change) converts the protocol's queued concurrency into engine co-residency. Also revises state-of-world finding (a): the conc-64 bench gain being only +7% was an artifact of the batch-8 cap, not near-exhausted batch amortization.
predicted_delta: +40-75% timeboxed decode_heavy tok/s (15.3 -> ~21-27; exp-0005 in-process B64/B8 ratio 32.2/17.0 = 1.89x ceiling, discounted for ~0.5 retires/step x 1.92 s serialized prefill admission at conc 64)

local_pregate.tf_gate: SKIPPED with cause: GPUs 4-7 occupied by the in-flight exp-0005 worker (dispatcher log: exp-0005 -> GPUs 4-7 at 06:08; nvidia-smi 06:10 shows ~140 GiB resident on each) with estimated release ~07:10; running the gate concurrently would corrupt exp-0005's canonical measurement (GPU exclusivity), and wait+gate (~58+25 min) exceeds the 40-min budget rule, so per the rule it was not started. Risk assessment: (1) diff is admission-cap-only — two default constants in server.py, zero kernel/numeric-path changes (git diff main --stat: 1 file, 2 insertions, 2 deletions); (2) full-model B=64 execution validated in-process on this exact engine by the exp-0005 profile arms (8 measured steps at B=64, passes A/B/C, /workspace/logs/t_profile_exp0005_2026-07-30.log); (3) the D13 gate is empirically insensitive to batching/scheduling diffs — warmup-0000 (per-sequence engine) and exp-0001 (batched-8 engine) logged IDENTICAL parity to 6 decimals (0.9587/0.611906/0.045308), meaning gate probes never co-reside, so max_batch cannot change gate results; only numeric-path diffs (exp-0002 dequant, exp-0003 grouped GEMM) have ever moved the parity numbers; (4) the worker re-runs the full D13 gate before any bench, so a red is caught without contaminating any canonical number.
local_pregate.determinism: unchanged mechanism: Scheduler admission is FCFS on (arrival_step, submit_seq) — fully deterministic; batched-decode row order = admission order. Same schedule -> same batch composition -> bitwise repeat, the exact property the worker's t_b3-derived determinism arm gated green at max_batch 8 in iters 2-5; the cap value does not enter the mechanism.
